investigation_notes.Description: A spike of 290 SharePoint file downloads was observed from the account using Directo MSGraph and a WinHttpRequest user agent, exceeding the user's 24-hour baseline of 50. The activity occurred at ~16:10 local time in Tallinn and targeted integration-oriented paths and financial documents, which is consistent with an automated integration or scheduled export rather than interactive browsing. No corroborating suspicious events or prior similar alerts were found, and the application/user-agent pattern aligns with service account or integration activity, so this alert is assessed as Low Priority based on the available evidence.
